name: video_finalize_draft
description: Render a draft video (resolution `Draft`) in 1080p, same shot, within 7 days of creating the draft. Never use `video_generate` for this: it makes a different video. Returns the existing HD instead of billing again. Then `creations_show`.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

force.description: Bill a new HD even if one exists. Only if the user asks.
